name: @cashlayer/contracts
description: Foundry smart contract suite for CashLayer Private Payroll

scripts.build: node -e "const { execSync } = require('child_process'); const p = process.env.USERPROFILE + '\\.foundry\\bin;' + process.env.PATH; execSync('forge build', { env: { ...process.env, PATH: p }, stdio: 'inherit' });"
scripts.test: node -e "const { execSync } = require('child_process'); const p = process.env.USERPROFILE + '\\.foundry\\bin;' + process.env.PATH; execSync('forge test -vvv', { env: { ...process.env, PATH: p }, stdio: 'inherit' });"
scripts.clean: node -e "const { execSync } = require('child_process'); const p = process.env.USERPROFILE + '\\.foundry\\bin;' + process.env.PATH; execSync('forge clean', { env: { ...process.env, PATH: p }, stdio: 'inherit' });"
